name: BTCPayServer
description: BTCPay Server is a free and open-source Bitcoin payment processor for self-hosted stores, invoices, checkout, wallets, point-of-sale flows, plugins, and webhooks without third-party payment processor fees.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Persistent BTCPay Server data directory. Back this directory up before processing real payments.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: BTCPay Server web interface and internal API port. Container port: 49392.

variables.name: Bind Address
variables.description: Address and port BTCPay binds to inside the container.

variables.name: Network
variables.description: Bitcoin network. Use mainnet, testnet, signet, or regtest.

variables.name: Chains
variables.description: Comma-separated crypto chains enabled in BTCPay. This template defaults to Bitcoin only.

variables.name: Public Host
variables.description: Optional public hostname, for example btcpay.example.com. Use a reverse proxy for HTTPS when exposing BTCPay outside your LAN.

variables.name: Root Path
variables.description: BTCPay root path when served from a subpath. Use / for normal deployments.

variables.name: Postgres Connection
variables.description: Required Postgres connection string for the BTCPay Server database.

variables.name: Explorer Postgres Connection
variables.description: Required Postgres connection string for NBXplorer data, used by BTCPay to read explorer state.

variables.name: BTC Explorer URL
variables.description: Required NBXplorer URL for Bitcoin, for example http://nbxplorer:32838/ on a custom Docker network or http://UNRAID-IP:32838/.

variables.name: Docker Deployment Mode
variables.description: Marks this BTCPay instance as Docker-deployed. Use true or false.

variables.name: No Default Chain
variables.description: Prevents BTCPay from assuming a chain without explicit chain variables. Use true or false.

variables.name: Update URL
variables.description: Release URL used by BTCPay to check for new versions.

variables.name: Debug Log
variables.description: Debug log filename under the BTCPay data directory.

variables.name: Lightning Connection
variables.description: Optional Bitcoin Lightning connection string. For example, type=clightning;server=unix://etc/clightning_bitcoin/lightning-rpc, or leave blank to configure later in BTCPay.
